description: Fill rules: a pentagram and two nested squares (same and opposite winding) under nonzero and evenodd, the rule roughjs uses for curve, polygon and path fills
toleranceNote: Every draw goes through ports of Chrome's own pipeline (Skia's analytic anti-aliasing, edge builder and clipper, stroker, dasher and AntiFillRect, Blink's arc handling), so what remains is rounding in blending, coverage and sampling: against Chrome 153 no pixel here is more than 1 level off. 8 leaves room for another Chrome build that rounds differently.
